brief.zh: 每一拍，把总线上的那一位原样交出去。
brief.en: Every tick, give out the bit on the bus as it is.

t.zh: 车上的控制器共用一根<wiki-ref to="bus"></wiki-ref>。这一章你造的是一个只听不说的探针：插上总线，弄清楚上面在说什么。
t.en: The controllers in a car share one <wiki-ref to="bus"></wiki-ref>. In this chapter you build a probe that only listens: plug it into the bus and work out what is being said on it.

t.zh: 探针每一拍跑一遍你的板。板左边的总线元件给出这一拍线上的那一位：0 是<wiki-ref to="dominant"></wiki-ref>，1 是<wiki-ref to="recessive"></wiki-ref>。运行就是时间：下面的波形一拍一格往前走。
t.en: The probe runs your board once a tick. The bus part on its left gives this tick’s bit on the line: 0 is <wiki-ref to="dominant"></wiki-ref>, 1 is <wiki-ref to="recessive"></wiki-ref>. Running is time: the waveform below moves on one tick a cell.

hint.zh: 把左边的总线元件接到右边的输出上。
hint.en: Wire the bus part on the left into the output on the right.

after.zh: 板每一拍从头跑一遍，只看得到这一拍。没人说话时线一直是隐性；一帧开始，线上才有了显性。
after.en: The board runs afresh each tick and sees only that tick. With nobody talking the line stays recessive; once a frame starts, dominant bits appear.
